<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary session concerns:</strong> The opposition Congress party has raised alarms over the unprecedented 88-day duration of the monsoon session, questioning the government&#x27;s legislative tactics.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>

</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Supreme Court rulings:</strong> The Supreme Court has ruled that the National Book Trust qualifies as a government entity under Article 12, while the government has allocated space for the Central Secretariat Library ahead of court proceedings.</li>
